sentences.text: The petitioners - accused Nos.1 to 5, who were sought to be prosecuted for the offences punishable under Sections 506, 498A, 323, 354 read with Section 34 of IPC, are before this Court.

4. The case of the prosecution is that, the accused No.1 is the husband, accused Nos.2 and 3 are the parents-in- laws and accused Nos.4 and 5 are the brothers-in-law, and they subjected the defacto complainant to cruelty both physically and mentally, and also a demand was made to bring money from the parental home.
5. The parties are present before this Court, and they have filed a joint affidavit stating that, they have amicably settled the dispute between among themselves in MC No.6346/2019 filed by the petitioner No.1, and in the said proceeding, as per the terms of settlement, the marriage of the accused No.1 and the defacto complainant has been dissolved mutually, and in terms of the settlement, the defacto complainant has no objection for quashing the impugned proceeding.
6. The joint affidavit is placed on record.
7.

Though the offences are cognizable and non- compoundable, however, having regard to the fact that, the parties have amicably settled the dispute among themselves, it would be futile exercise if the petitioners - accused Nos.1 to 5 are subjected to trial, since the probability of their conviction is remote and bleak in view of the settlement.
Hence, the NC: 2023:KHC:28656 continuation of criminal proceeding will be an abuse of process of law.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i) Criminal petition is allowed.
ii) The impugned proceeding in CC No.3606/2017 arising out of Crime No.268/2016 pending on the file of the learned 8th ACMM, Bangalore, is hereby quashed.

Sd/-
